title: Metabolism and Nutrition in Neurointensive Care
summary: The aim of the study is to study the impact of metabolism, inflammation and immobilization on muscle weakness (ICU acquired weakness) developing during intensive care.

interventions.name: Individualized clinical nutrition according to  international guidelines (DGEM, ESPEN, ASPEN)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Neurological disease as primary ICU admission diagnosis
- Expected length of ICU stay more than 5 days (according to judgement of treating clinicians)
- Inclusion <48 hours after ICU admission
- Indication for clinical nutrition (according to local SOP/guidelines)
Exclusion criteria:
- Age < 18 years
- Prior ICU treatment > 24 hours during the same hospital admission
